tn_upper_middle_creek.name: Upper Middle Creek
tn_upper_middle_creek.note: Only a Chattanooga-wide guide (Dec-Feb best, Oct-Apr for Stone Fort); nothing for Middle Creek itself; madboulder notes only that some boulders are wet in summer.

ut_southern_wasatch.name: Southern Wasatch
ut_southern_wasatch.note: One travel guide gives May-Oct for American Fork; no second agreeing source; Provo Canyon is ice.

wi_east_bluff_07_railroad_tracks.name: East Bluff 07 - Railroad Tracks
wi_east_bluff_07_railroad_tracks.note: KAYA Devil's Lake overview names Sep-Nov as prime and Mar-Jun as great; a guidebook page says spring and fall best. Taken for the whole Devil's Lake park.

az_high_rappel_area.name: High Rappel Area
az_high_rappel_area.note: Prescott guides say spring and fall (season words only) or year-round; no months; Thumb Butte falcon closure is a different place.

bc_east_kootenay_2.name: East Kootenay
bc_east_kootenay_2.note: Only Cranbrook tourism (early/late season, Oct larches) and a travel page (May, Sep shoulders); no month-naming climbing source.

co_buffalo_creek.name: Buffalo Creek
co_buffalo_creek.note: Only a Front Range-wide window (May-Oct); not specific to Buffalo Creek; MP chart unreadable.

id_central_idaho.name: Central Idaho
id_central_idaho.note: Region too broad (all central Idaho); no single season applies.

oh_salt_fork_state_park.name: Salt Fork State Park
oh_salt_fork_state_park.note: Only 'fall' from one article; MP says climbing may not be allowed in the park.

vt_bolton_area.name: Bolton Area
vt_bolton_area.note: MP forum says Apr-Oct most reliable (Mar-Dec possible); Northern Vermont guide says good climbing into early November; fall best for cool rock. Weak, forum-heavy.

wa_phun_rock_and_nearby_crags.name: Phun Rock and Nearby Crags
wa_phun_rock_and_nearby_crags.note: Sources give only Hwy 20 closure mid-Nov to mid-Apr and snowy early season; no named climbing months.

wv_tilted_tree.name: Tilted Tree
wv_tilted_tree.note: Nothing season-specific for Coopers Rock bouldering found.

wy_fremont_canyon.name: Fremont Canyon
wy_fremont_canyon.note: Visit Casper says spring-fall, shoulders excellent (season words only).

az_reef_of_rocks.name: Reef of Rocks
az_reef_of_rocks.note: Lower highway is a winter area; upper highway cooler months; no months named; nothing specific to Reef of Rocks.

co_forest_boulders.name: Forest Boulders
co_forest_boulders.note: Only the Front Range-wide May-Oct; nothing for Castle View Forest Boulders.

md_sugarloaf_mountain.name: Sugarloaf Mountain
md_sugarloaf_mountain.note: Spring and fall best, winter shady (season words only).

wy_area_5_red_and_white_grotto_walls.name: Area 5: Red and White Grotto Walls
wy_area_5_red_and_white_grotto_walls.note: Only a Wyoming-wide Oct-May remark; nothing for Guernsey.

az_icecapades.name: Icecapades
az_icecapades.note: No seasonal source found; name suggests ice/winter but unverified.

az_camelback_mountain.name: Camelback Mountain
az_camelback_mountain.note: No season source; only trip reports in Jan and Oct.

bc_grohman_narrows.name: Grohman Narrows
bc_grohman_narrows.note: HELD by reviewer: regional tourism months only. Nelson tourism names Apr-Oct as best outdoor climbing months (hardy extend); local Grohman page says spring is awesome, Jul-Sep hot. Regional (Nelson) months; Grohman-specific guide only speaks in season words.
